difference_explained: The 7 physical UNIQUE indexes include the 5 declared UNIQUE constraints plus 2 partial UNIQUE indexes (cvd_sale_unique, payables_unique_pendente) that are enforced by CREATE UNIQUE INDEX (with WHERE predicate) rather than by a table-level UNIQUE constraint. Partial uniques are not representable as UNIQUE constraints in PostgreSQL, hence they count as indexes but not as constraints. No fabrication; direct pg_index vs pg_constraint reconciliation.
removal_rule: No PK/UNIQUE-backing index may be removed independently of its constraint. All 32 constraint-backing indexes remain in PRESERVE_AS_CONSTRAINT_BACKING_INDEX. Tenant-composite uniqueness (categorias, payment_routing_rules, user_roles) will be introduced by NEW constraints in a later stage; legacy user_id-based UNIQUE constraints only drop after replacement validation, per F3 GLOBAL_TO_TENANT_COMPOSITE_UNIQUENESS_TRANSITION plan.
